brief:
Two Palestinian teenagers were killed in the occupied West Bank as Israeli settlers and snipers surrounded a village, Al Jazeera English reported. The incident represents the latest deadly confrontation in an area experiencing a recent surge in settler violence and military operations.

The deaths occurred during escalating tensions between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers in the territory. Local witnesses described a heavy presence of Israeli military personnel and settlers in the vicinity at the time of the killings. Authorities have not yet released a detailed account of the circumstances that led to the teenagers' deaths, though investigations into the incident are ongoing.
dek: Two Palestinian teens were killed in the occupied West Bank as Israeli settlers and snipers surround a village.
title: Israeli settlers and snipers kill two Palestinian teens in West Bank village
